description: Implementation of the proposed Smart Meters with Time-of-Use Billing System by Electricity Distribution Lanka (Private) Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-10-21 to obtain a loan of US$ 15 million through the Small Expenditure Financing facility of the Asian Development Bank to complementary projects that contribute to strengthening the country’s renewable energy efforts. At the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-09-03, approval has been granted to the use of US$ 2.5 million from the said loan to prepare the detailed design and tender documents for the Maha Oya Pumped Storage Hydropower Plant Development Project. The remaining US$ 12.5 million is proposed to be used to implement a project to install 300,000 Smart Meters with a Time-of-Use Billing System as part of Sri Lanka's Smart Grid Modernization initiative. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to implement the said project by Electricity Distribution Lanka (Private) Limited within a period of 02 years was, approved by the Cabinet of Ministers.
